name: GhostFileUploadDropzone
description: Drop target for file drags (div, no role, not a tab stop). A click on a non-interactive area opens the picker as a pointer convenience; the trigger stays the keyboard control. Cancels file drags even when disabled so a drop never navigates the page, and installs the shared document drop guard while mounted and enabled.

slots.name: default

props.name: dragging
props.description: A file drag is over the dropzone.

slots.description: Drop target content; receives dragging while a file drag is over the zone.

states.name: dragging
states.description: A file drag is over the zone. Wins over invalid and disabled.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Root is disabled; drags and clicks are ignored.
